root_cause_label: Terminal State Desynchronization + Ungated Execution: packageVersion checks returned no output (rstan absent), but agent repeatedly ran analysis.R without confirmed installation, then cycled through futile install-verify-execute loops with no real progress
one_sentence_failure_summary: After rstan installation commands produced no confirmable output and a filesystem state mismatch surfaced at step 11 (only data.csv in /app), the agent repeatedly attempted to run analysis.R without ever verifying rstan was installed, devolving into an endless loop of redundant checks and premature executions.
t_err_evidence: Step 17: agent runs `ITER=2000 Rscript /app/analysis.R` despite `packageVersion('rstan')` at step 16 producing '(command executed successfully with no output)' — a clear signal rstan is absent — resulting in 'Error in library(rstan) : there is no package called rstan'; the decisive mistake is executing without confirmed installation.
t_commit_evidence: Step 17: the analysis script fails with a missing-package error and from this point the agent enters a stereotyped cycle (install-verify-execute-check) that never succeeds; the same pattern repeats unbroken to step 85 with no corrective divergence, locking in the failing outcome.
t_surface_evidence: Step 17 terminal output: 'Error in library(rstan) : there is no package called rstan' — first externally observable failure signal.
trigger_explanation: At step 16, `R -q -e "packageVersion('rstan')"` returns '(command executed successfully with no output)' — in R, a missing package would produce an error or no version output, signaling rstan is not installed. Additionally, step 11 showed the /app directory containing only data.csv (Stan and R scripts apparently lost), and step 17's execution confirms the signal. The agent saw these disconfirming cues and proceeded anyway.
forewarning_evidence: Step 11: terminal shows only data.csv in /app (Stan model and analysis.R scripts apparently missing, contradicting agent's belief). Steps 10 and 16: `packageVersion('rstan')` commands return empty or no-output results, signaling rstan may not be installed.
